c74object.name: pyosc.agent
c74object.digest: OSC Agent for using with the python maxosc package
c74object.description: OSC Agent for using with the python maxosc package

objarg.name: filepath
objarg.digest: Relative path to python script to launch (default: null)
objarg.description: Path to python script to launch with the 'initialize' command. To handle launch manually, use 'null' (default) in combination with @autoinitialize 0

objarg.name: sendport
objarg.description: OSC send port. Use 'auto' to automatically assign port when using multiple pyosc.agent. The port will be forwarded as the receive port of the remote python Agent class when launched from Max

objarg.name: recvport
objarg.description: OSC receive port. Use 'auto' to automatically assign port when using multiple pyosc.agent. The port will be forwarded as the send port of the remote python Agent class when launched from Max

method.name: initialize
method.digest: Initialize the agent. Requires the 'filepath' argument to be non-null
method.description: When fully initialized, the pyosc.agent will output the message 'initialized' on its first outlet

method.name: reinitialize
method.digest: Reinitializes the agent (calls terminate, waits for termination and then calls initialize)

method.name: terminate
method.description: When terminated, the pyosc.agent will output the message 'terminated' on ints first outlet

method.name: rawsend
method.description: This is identical to 'anything' except that it also allows calling functions that conflicts keywords of the pyosc.agent (e.g. rawsend initialize)

attribute.name: args
attribute.digest: Extra arguments to pass to python script on launch
attribute.description: Typically passed with double dashes, e.g. @args --extra_arg1 123 --extra_arg2 456

attribute.name: autoterminate
attribute.digest: Terminate script when the object is deleted (default: 1)

attribute.name: loglevel
attribute.digest: Set the log level (0: info, 1: warning, 2: error, 3: debug)

attribute.name: quiet
attribute.digest: Suppress all non-launch related messages to Max console (default: 0)

attribute.name: timeout
attribute.digest: Time in milliseonds until remote is flagged as offline if no heartbeat is received (default: 15000)

attribute.name: follower
attribute.digest: For multiple pyosc.agent objects with single remote, see maxhelp (default: 0)"
